tei:div.tei:p: phaṭa/ ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam thar gsum gyi sgo 'byed ma/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams 'joms mdzad ma/ /lab sgron khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rje dgongs la byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /'og min chos sku'i pho brang du/ /yum chen sher phyin byin rlabs can/ /byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo snyem thags chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la/ /bcom ldan shāka thub byin rlabs can/ / sogs/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga ru/ /'jam dpal smra seng sogs/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ /rje btsun sgrol ma sogs/ dag pa'i bde stong mkha' sbyod du/ /rdo rje phag mo sogs/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang du/ su kha siddhi sogs/ rgya gar 'jags ma'i spyil po ru/ /ārya de ba sogs/ la stod deng ri gling stod du/ /dam pa sangs rgyas sogs/ ra sa spang lung dgon pa ru/ /bsod nams bla ma sogs/ zangs ri mkhar dmar dgon pa ru/ /ma cig lab sgron sogs/ rgyal thang chu gtsang dgon pa ru/ /bsam bstan 'od zer sogs/ byang chub gling gi dben gnas su/ /nam mkha' 'od zer sogs/ gnyan khrod brgya rtsa'i gnas mchog tu/ /shākya 'od zer sogs/ phyogs med yangs pa'i ri khrod du/ /bde gshegs mtshan can sogs/ byin rlabs bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /dbon sras chos legs sogs/ kha rag bsam gling dgon pa ru/ /g.yu phrug sher dpal sogs/ chos lung byang rtse'i dben gnas su/ /rje btsun grol mchog sogs/ brag stod rdo rje'i pho brang du/ /chos sku lha dbang sogs/ chos 'byung bdag med pho brang du/ /lung rig rgya mtsho byin rlabs can/ /byin rlabs can la sogs ba 'debs/ /blo snyem thag chod par byin gyis rlobs/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i spyi bo ru/ /kun dga' snying po sogs/ bdud rtsi phug gi dben gnas su/ /grags pa dpal bzang sogs/ gnod sbyin ming gi dgon pa ru/

/kun dga' rin chen sogs/ 'bral med snying gi dkyil nang du/ /'phrin las rnam rgyal sogs/ spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog tu/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs/ bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /chos skyong srung ma sogs/ dag snang phyogs med gzhal yas su/ /rdo rje spun grogs sogs/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /re sa gzhan na med pa'i byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag 'dzin blo'i thongs bar= /skye med 'od gsal rtogs par= /bar chod dngos grub long bar= /bdud tshogs rang sar chod par= /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / khyad par du bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi bla ma la mos gus drag po'i gsol ba 'debs par bsam/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs de nyid bdag 'jug gi mgor 'don par bya'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ PAGE 333- -- PAGE 333 -- PAGE 332 -
